lines.text: A widow's creditor threatens to take her two sons, so Elisha has her fill borrowed jars from one jar.
A prominent Shunem woman persuades Elisha to eat, then asks her husband to make a small room upstairs for him.
Gehazi says the woman has no son and her husband is old, and Elisha promises her a son.
The woman goes to Elisha at Mount Sinai, and Gehazi lays Elisha's staff on the boy's face without response.
Elisha prays to the LORD and stretches himself over the boy twice, and the boy sneezes three times.
